population: All adult admissions with consistent admission fields and explicit alive/dead ICU status; no selection by predictions or effect sizes.
grouping: One physical row per patient_number, after all selected admission fields and discharge status are checked identical including missingness across repeated daily rows. Conflicting identifiers are excluded and reported, not combined field by field.
predictor_exclusions: diagnoses or treatments not explicitly mapped
admission_proxy: first heart rate as day-one maximum
first systolic pressure as day-one minimum
unit_evidence_status: Explicit hypothetical sensitivity assumptions, not verified source units. Both creatinine conventions retained regardless of results; no unit chosen using outcome performance.
models: Five median and five KNN frozen no-APACHE WiDS checkpoints; no training or recalibration; gamma and all rules fixed.
inference: 50 matched MC-dropout draws, seed 0 per checkpoint/scenario; uniform-gate identity and independent persisted replay.
analysis: All scenarios and seeds reported; paired ICU-outcome Brier and AUROC deltas with conditional admission bootstrap; five-seed mean and SD. No hospital clustering possible; canonical repeat-person linkage unavailable. No external acceptance or numerical compatibility claim under a changed endpoint.
primary_contrast: NARS minus MC-only; descriptive exploratory comparison with three prespecified scenarios, no outcome-driven scenario selection.
claim_boundary: Changes in endpoint, measurement summaries, missing inputs, assumed units and unverified source independence prevent completion of plan experiment 7. No human or clinical validation.
